_comment: Advisories scripts/ci/audit.sh pnpm may ignore. Every entry needs id (CVE or GHSA), reason and expires (YYYY-MM-DD); an expired entry fails the lane. Only an advisory with no fixed release reachable from our consumers belongs here — anything with a fix is pinned through pnpm.overrides in the root package.json instead (CLAUDE.md §9).

allow.reason: node-forge (CVE-2026-85393, RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements, high): NO upstream fix exists - the advisory's vulnerable range is <=1.4.0 with no first_patched_version, and 1.4.0 is the latest release on the registry (the root override already pins it there). Transitive through apps/mobile only (expo, @expo/vector-icons, @react-native-community/datetimepicker -> Expo CLI tooling); not a dependency of the API, web app or bots, and not on any request path. Re-check when node-forge ships a fixed release.
